goals.text: Digital billing adoption at or above 70%

achievements: Smart-meter self-service portal launched in February
Digital billing adoption reached 71%, up from 58%
Call-center volume down 18% year over year
challenges: Billing-run failures in April affected about 3,200 customers
Portal accessibility audit found 12 issues (4 critical)
Regulator inquiry on estimated bills is still open
risks: The regulator inquiry could result in a fine or mandated process changes
Billing-run failures may recur when the new tariff structure launches in Q3

action_items.text: Root-cause analysis of April billing failures

notes: Half-year period: no calendar quarter (warning expected). Customer is the Retail Division only. Two-column highlight box. Owner initials resolved by a legend (either form accepted). 'TBC' = unknown due date. Goals table says uptime 99.5% met, appendix says H1 average 99.3% -> conflict; either value accepted for the KPI.
